answer: Bind each identity to a hardware-backed key that cannot be copied: before trading, an agent must present a fresh attestation from its own secure enclave proving it controls one unique device, and its key is recorded once, never re-issued. A sybil farmer would need a separate physical device for every clone, like growing a lotus from a separate root rather than painting copies with the same pigment. Each clone must also pass a slow, sequential check, so a plume of fake identities cannot be spun up in parallel; cloning multiplies hardware and waiting time, not influence.
